policy.failedStandalonePolicy: retain for interaction and leave-one-family-out ablation; zero predictive weight allowed if full-stack evidence remains negative
policy.confirmedXI: player props and final XI-dependent team impact are actionable only after both official starting XIs are available
policy.competitionDomainPolicy: domain classification does not itself grant predictive promotion or funding; each domain requires causal validation and clean prospective confirmation

formation.source: ESPN actual formation / Understat starter-shape fallback

tacticalMatchup.source: Understat npxG/npxGA, deep/deep_allowed, PPDA/PPDA-allowed where exposed, plus formation/role shape

shotStoppingGoalkeeper.source: confirmed GK identity plus pre-kickoff team shot-stopping residual from goals conceded versus npxGA; explicitly not treated as pure keeper skill when identity history is unavailable

setPieces.source: Understat shot situation for corner/set-piece/direct-free-kick shots and xG where exposed

referee.source: Football-Data referee field + pre-match historical cards with league shrinkage

weatherVenue.role: context until strict historical forecast archive validation
weatherVenue.source: Open-Meteo forecast for live; no actual-weather hindsight allowed for promotion

motivationCompetition.source: pre-match reconstructed league table and points-gap state

benchSubstitution.source: confirmed bench depth + prior substitution timing where roster minutes are available

playerTeamImpact.source: expected/confirmed XI player attacking contribution, replacement quality, defensive/GK continuity

teamToScoreAttribution.source: component decomposition of team scoring intensity

redCards.source: Football-Data event model; holdout did not improve baseline

competitionDomain.source: public fixture identity plus senior international historical identity; separates club, senior national, youth and women namespaces

internationalStructuralState.source: pinned senior men's full-international history plus causally prior completed-result supplement

internationalRecentPerformance.source: causally prior senior international results with opponent-strength context

internationalCompetitionState.source: qualification/group/table state and tournament importance; must be point-in-time

clubToCountryPlayerTransfer.source: causal club player form/availability translated into expected or confirmed national-team XI

internationalSquadContinuity.source: prior senior national squads/XIs, call-up continuity and camp availability
